literal_meaning: চোখের উপর কিছু পড়া (eyes falling on something)
figurative_meaning_en: To catch one's eye; to attract attention
example_sentences_in_bangla: এতদিনে ভাঙা বাড়ীর দিকে চোখ পড়েছে।
বইয়ের দোকানে একটা আকর্ষণীয় কভারের উপর চোখ পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: Finally, his eyes fell on the broken house.
My eyes fell on an attractive book cover in the shop.
note: This idiom is a standard expression in Bengali for sudden or delayed notice.
